basic_details.job_title: DLSA Balangir Para-Legal Volunteers Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The District Legal Services Authority (DLSA), Balangir invites expressions of interest from local residents of Balangir District for empanelment as Para-Legal Volunteers (PLVs) for a tenure of one year; the notice does not fix a number of posts. Applications in the prescribed format go by post or by the drop box at the ADR Centre Building, Balangir, to The Secretary, DLSA, Balangir, and must be received by 31 October 2026 at 5.00 PM. Applications received after the due date shall not be considered.

qualification.details: Teachers (including retired teachers) Retired Government Servants and senior citizens M.S.W students and teachers Anganwadi Workers Doctor / Physician Students and Law Students (till they enrolled as lawyer) Members of non-political, service-oriented NGOs and Clubs Members of Women Neighbourhood Groups, Maithri Sanghams and other Self-Help Groups, including of marginalized / vulnerable groups Educated prisoners with good behaviour, serving long term sentence in prison Any other persons whom the District Legal Services Authority deems fit to be identified as Para-Legal Volunteers | The PLVs shall be literate, preferably matriculate, with a capacity for overall comprehension. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions. | The age limit is not specified in the notice; the application form asks for the age as on 01.10.2026. | The work of Para-Legal Volunteers does not carry any salary, remuneration or wages except honorarium fixed by the DLSA/ SLSA/NALSA from time to time. The notice does not print the honorarium amount.

selection_process: The selection of Para-Legal Volunteers shall be made as per the "Empanelment Process" of the NALSA Scheme. The number of PLVs to be empanelled will be decided as per the proper requirement
Willingness to work Computer knowledge Sincerity Punctuality Integrity

This assessment follows the Scheme for Para Legal Volunteers (Revised) and the NALSA module for the orientation-induction-refresher courses for PLV training. The Authority reserves the right to accept or reject any application for expression of interest without assigning any reason.
important_instructions: Empanelment is for a tenure of one year from the date of empanelment. A PLV shall be disqualified and removed from the panel if he/she fails to evince interest in the scheme. A PLV shall be disqualified and removed if he/she has been adjudged insolvent, or has been accused of an offence. A PLV shall be disqualified and removed if he/she has become physically or mentally incapable. A PLV shall be disqualified and removed if he/she has so abused his/her position or misconducted in any manner as to render his/her continuance prejudicial to the public interest, or is an active political enthusiast of a political party. Any such PLV may be removed by the Chairman, DLSA after suitable enquiry, and intimation is to be sent to the State Legal Services Authority. For any query, contact the official phone number of DLSA, Balangir: 8280723207.

content_sections.heading: About DLSA Balangir Para-Legal Volunteers
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Balangir functions from the ADR Centre in the Civil Courts Premises, Balangir, Odisha. Para-Legal Volunteers are empanelled under the Scheme for Para Legal Volunteers (Revised) of NALSA and work under the direction of the DLSA, Balangir. Empanelment is for one year from the date of empanelment.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the written expression of interest in the prescribed format to this address, by post or by putting it in the drop box kept in the ADR Centre Building, Balangir: The Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, ADR Centre, Civil Courts Premises, Balangir, P.O: Balangir, Dist.: Balangir, Odisha, PIN-767001 Name of the applicant and Father/Husband's name Date of birth and age as on 01.10.2026 Gender (Male/Female/Transgender) Permanent and present address with contact number and WhatsApp number (At, P.S, P.O, G.P, Block, District, PIN) Educational qualification, if any, and work experience, if any Place of preference to work and special interest in any field, if any Signed declaration to work as Para Legal Volunteer and abide by the directions of the DLSA, Balangir as per the Scheme for Para Legal Volunteers (Revised) FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Teachers (including retired teachers) Retired Government Servants and senior citizens M.S.W students and teachers Anganwadi Workers Doctor / Physician Students and Law Students (till they enrolled as lawyer) Members of non-political, service-oriented NGOs and Clubs Members of Women Neighbourhood Groups, Maithri Sanghams and other Self-Help Groups, including of marginalized / vulnerable groups Educated prisoners with good behaviour, serving long term sentence in prison Any other persons whom the District Legal Services Authority deems fit to be identified as Para-Legal Volunteers The PLVs shall be literate, preferably matriculate, with a capacity for overall comprehension. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions. The age limit is not specified in the notice; the application form asks for the age as on 01.10.2026. The work of Para-Legal Volunteers does not carry any salary, remuneration or wages except honorarium fixed by the DLSA/ SLSA/NALSA from time to time. The notice does not print the honorarium amount.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format Two recent passport size photographs (one to be pasted on the application form in the space provided; the form asks for a self-attested photo) A self-addressed envelope, duly stamped

content_sections.heading: Selection Process

The number of PLVs to be empanelled will be decided as per the proper requirement, assessing: Willingness to work Computer knowledge Sincerity Punctuality Integrity This assessment follows the Scheme for Para Legal Volunteers (Revised) and the NALSA module for the orientation-induction-refresher courses for PLV training. The Authority reserves the right to accept or reject any application for expression of interest without assigning any reason.

A PLV shall be disqualified and removed if he/she has become physically or mentally incapable. A PLV shall be disqualified and removed if he/she has so abused his/her position or misconducted in any manner as to render his/her continuance prejudicial to the public interest, or is an active political enthusiast of a political party. Any such PLV may be removed by the Chairman, DLSA after suitable enquiry, and intimation is to be sent to the State Legal Services Authority. faq.question: Q1. How many Para-Legal Volunteers will DLSA Balangir empanel?
faq.answer: The notice gives no fixed number; PLVs will be empanelled as per the proper requirement of the DLSA, Balangir.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the DLSA Balangir PLV application?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 31 October 2026 at 5.00 PM; applications received after the due date shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed to become a Para-Legal Volunteer in Balangir?
faq.answer: PLVs shall be literate, preferably matriculate, with a capacity for overall comprehension.

faq.question: Q4. Who can apply for DLSA Balangir Para-Legal Volunteers?
faq.answer: Local residents of Balangir District, such as teachers, retired government servants, senior citizens, MSW students, Anganwadi workers, doctors, students, NGO and Self-Help Group members, and others the DLSA deems fit.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Para-Legal Volunteer at DLSA Balangir?
faq.answer: There is no salary, remuneration or wages; PLVs get only an honorarium fixed by the DLSA/ SLSA/NALSA from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for DLSA Balangir PLV empanelment?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed form with two passport size photographs and a self-addressed stamped envelope by post or drop box to The Secretary, DLSA, ADR Centre, Civil Courts Premises, Balangir, Odisha, PIN-767001.

faq.question: Q7. How are Para-Legal Volunteers selected in Balangir?
faq.answer: Selection follows the Empanelment Process of the NALSA Scheme, assessing willingness to work, computer knowledge, sincerity, punctuality and integrity.

faq.question: Q8. Is the PLV empanelment at DLSA Balangir permanent?
faq.answer: No, empanelment is for a tenure of one year from the date of empanelment, and a PLV may be removed from the panel on the grounds listed in the notice.

faq.question: Q9. Can a law student apply as a Para-Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: Yes, students and law students may apply, till they are enrolled as lawyers.
